title: Lever: verdict.json wrapper so regime_cell_walkforward / regime_adx_cutpoint_sweep can land queue results (live-leg cell evidence)
note: Found by QUEUE-FILL-W41. The two real cell-evidence tools write stdout/--json only and their workflows (regime-cell-walkforward.yml, regime-adx-cutpoint-sweep.yml) take no research_unit input, so a queue unit cannot land a result from them; research-script-run.yml needs verdict.json. Build: a scripts/research/ wrapper that runs the walkforward over a list of (strategy, regime) cells and writes verdict.json with one record per cell (stable_drag / fold_sensitive / insufficient_n), then regime units per live leg lacking cell evidence (regime-selectivity Rule 2). Closes when a queue unit built on it lands a result record. Roadmap L-REGIME.
